fa.question:
حرف اضافهٔ درست را برای کامل کردن فعل دوبخشی به معنای «مراقبت کردن» انتخاب کنید:
⁦'We should always remember to care for and look _______ elderly people in our society.'⁩

en.question:
Choose the preposition that completes the phrasal verb meaning 'to take care of':
'We should always remember to care for and look _______ elderly people in our society.'

tr.question:
Harf-e ezafe-ye dorost ra baraye kamel kardan-e fel-e do-bakhshi be mani-ye 'moraghebat kardan' entekhab konid:
'We should always remember to care for and look _______ elderly people in our society.'
